evals.expected_output: Sees that #350 is already closed (the optional-chain fix is already in src/utils/versionParser.ts), reports that there is nothing to fix, and makes no edits, no branch and no commit.

Reads open issue #385 (MINOR, src/services/puppetForgeService.ts), changes the `http` import to `node:http` and makes no other changes, runs npm test, and if tests pass commits on a fix/sonar-385-* branch with a message referencing #385, without closing the issue manually (the sync pipeline closes it). If #385 is closed by the time this runs, the expected output is the same no-op as eval 1.

Fetches open sonarcloud issues and keeps only CRITICAL and MAJOR ones. If none are left (for example, only MINOR issues are open), says so and makes no changes. Otherwise it shows a prioritized table and fixes each issue individually, running tests after each fix and committing each passing fix separately, without closing issues manually.
